Features.Title: Side Entry Grid is now the default
Features.Description: Shift Cash Drop and Cash On Hand keep their full transaction grids, with entry fields beside them for faster recording.

Features.Title: Choose your preferred layout
Features.Description: Use View at the top to choose Classic Grid, Side Entry Grid or Guided Grid for each section. Your choices are remembered.

Features.Title: Remember payees and payout reasons
Features.Description: Type a new Paid To / Vendor or Purpose / Reason, or select a saved one. After a successful save, the choices are available in both sections for the same store.

Features.Title: Review before saving with Guided Grid
Features.Description: Guided Grid lets you review the entry before confirming. Changing layouts keeps an unfinished entry in place.

Features.Title: Existing drop and payout accounting continues
Features.Description: Verified batches update their shift and cash balance; pending drops wait for the matching store report. Existing corrections and month-close rules remain in place.
